title: toybox variables
description: Configuration variables for Toybox across POSIX, Windows native (MSVC), and MS-DOS (dos32).

TOYBOX_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install toybox. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs (dos32 on MS-DOS, PE on Windows, static on Linux), 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

TOYBOX_VERSION.description: Specific version of toybox to install (e.g., 0.8.15 on Windows/MS-DOS or latest).

TOYBOX_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading toybox binary or archive artifacts.

TOYBOX_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying toybox available remote releases.

TOYBOX_INSTALL_SHIMS.description: When set to '1', materializes per-applet hardlinks or .bat/.exe trampolines in bin/ when freebsd-usr-bin is not installed.
